authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local plan dataset has separate rows for current, emerging and historical local plans and can link each plan to its local-plan-boundary reference. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan reference/name, local-plan-boundary reference, responsible organisation code, LPA/LAD identifier/name, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Selecting any plan or linked coverage polygon would therefore require guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
